item.title: Dirdie Birdie opens mini golf, dining in Fort Worth's West 7th
item.description: The Dirdie Birdie, a Texas-born restaurant and interactive entertainment concept, will open a new location in Fort Worth this summer.

item.title: Yamaha’s 40 Under 40 shines the spotlight on a Fort Worth educator
item.description: Yamaha has honored 40 music educators under the age of 40 for their courage, creativity, and growth in music instruction, including Rolando Rivera, the Mariachi Director at Diamond Hill-Jarvis High School in Fort Worth, Texas.

item.title: Dallas Drive brings pro cheer to North Texas with new league
item.description: The Pro Cheer League is the world's first professional cheer league for athletes 18 and older, providing elite competitors with the opportunity to train, perform and compete professionally, and the Dallas Drive is one of four inaugural teams in the league.

item.title: Murray Hidary's silent piano experience set for Dallas show
item.description: MindTravel's Silent Piano Experience, featuring pianist Murray Hidary, will take place at Klyde Warren Park in Dallas on March 18, offering attendees a tranquil escape through music.

item.title: Oak & Stone expands in North Texas with new Addison restaurant
item.description: Oak & Stone, an American restaurant with a self-pour tap wall and housemade dishes, will open a new location in Addison in summer 2026.

item.title: Magnum launches Coachella sweepstakes
item.description: Magnum Ice Cream will be the first-ever frozen dessert sponsor of Coachella, providing ice cream, a customization station, and a chance to win admission to the festival.

item.title: Resting Kyrie is 100 percent the right move
item.description: The Dallas Mavericks have decided to keep Kyrie Irving out for the rest of the season to protect their draft potential and to mentor their young core.

item.title: Toasted Yolk Cafe to open first Amarillo location
item.description: The Toasted Yolk Cafe will open its first Amarillo location on March 9, 2026, and will host two VIP soft opening events to benefit Amarillo Angels before the official grand opening.

item.title: El Chico offers free meals for kids during spring break
item.description: El Chico is offering a Kids Eat Free promotion from March 16-20, allowing children ages 12 and younger to receive a free meal with the purchase of an adult entrée.

item.title: Omar heckles Trump during comments about Somali community
